newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Eyeing floating price, India.
newsitem.headline: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Eyeing floating price, India.

text.p: Most light distllate traders moved to the sidelines on Thursday, waiting for the result of a potential naphtha trade and the results of India's gasoline tender.
A U.S. major was close to selling 240,000 barrels of light naphtha lifting early July at around 70 cents per barrel over spot quotes, fob Singapore to a Japanese trader.

"It is possible," a trader said on the premium. "The buyer needs to cover a short and there are very few barrels available from Singapore in the first place...and even fewer which are a full MR size."
In July, at least one 100,000 barrel parcel lifting mid-month remained, he said.
But other traders said the premium was "a bit on the high side" as the market was currently being assessed around 40-50 cents in the light of ample supplies in the region.
They said other than Singapore barrels, there were still South Korean barrel available.
"Naphtha is a bit long with the arb open," a trader with a major oil company said. "There must be cargoes being fixed...it is just a question of who brings them in first."
July naphtha swaps firmed with crude, edging up five cents from Wednesday to $21.10/$21.25 per barrel with August at five cents in contango.
Gasoline was also firmer as traders returned to bid on the fixed price fob Singapore market after more than a week's silence.
Bids rose within the day to $23.60 from $23.30 per barrel for 92-octane unleaded barrels lifting fob Singapore end June to early July.
But sellers stayed out of the market ahead of India's buy tender award.
"We are not going to offer, we are waiting for results from IOC," said a refiner.

State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is seeking by tender 25,000 tonnes of 87-octane leaded gasoline for June 26-30 delivery to the west coast due to a shortfall caused by the emergency five-day shutdown of the 150,000 barrels-per-day Cochin refinery on June 2.
The tender closes Thursday and is valid for a day.
